verified_desc: supermarket operator (Winston Schaefer, Inc., owner of Pioneer Supermarket)
evidence_title: The Cattleman, July 1961 (Vol. 48, Iss. 2)
evidence_quote: E. C. Gise, president of Winston Schaefer, Inc., owner of the Pioneer Supermarket on Los Angeles' Sunset Boulevard. The steers were to be fed out in Arizona, shipped to a packing plant in California for slaughter and then retailed in the Pioneer Supermarket.
researcher_notes: Corrects the current call (real estate/property). The Cattleman names Winston Schaefer, Inc. as owner of the Pioneer Supermarket on Sunset Blvd in 1960-61; the directory gives Winston Schaefer the same phone as Pioneer Mkt at 1601 (MA 6-7186), and a 1978 ERIC teaching module (archive.org/details/micro_IA41153337_0741) lists 'Pioneer Market 1601 W. Sunset ... Phone; 626-7186 Hours: 24 hours daily'. So the 1956-65 listing is the supermarket's operating company, not a separate real-estate office. A later 'Winston Schaefer Realty Co' appears at 1910 W Sunset (1987 directory; LA Office of Finance account start 1970), which may be where the 'later Winston Schaefer Realty Co' basis came from. Effect: lot 1601 loses its Finance/real-estate bucket in these years (it already has Food stores from Pioneer Mkt).
